name: FPLXI fantasy football analytics landing page by fplxi.com
description: A data-dense fantasy football analytics landing page set on warm off-white paper, led by a floating black pill nav and a live gameweek ticker. The hero pairs a large serif headline and inline two-step form with a real model leaderboard, so the product's data does the persuading. Down the page the rhythm alternates hairline-bordered white data cards (best XI pitch view, fixtures, position leaders, accuracy charts) with full-black punctuation bands (testimonial, dark stat card), before loosening into pricing with deliberately blurred locked rows and a two-column FAQ accordion. Typography carries the identity: uppercase letterspaced micro-labels, monospaced tabular numerals in every table, and one indigo-blue accent reserved for CTAs and chart bars.
